prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds revealed in
earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only tells you how often this line type was paid at all.
- If you decide the line is indemnified and no cap, sub-limit or percentage reduction applies,
  take the stated amount as t and give a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. These
  amounts are before such policy arithmetic; apply caps and reductions on top.
- A line type that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies
  do not carry; price it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger": indemnified in 1 of 2 earlier cases, t = 0 in 1; when indemnified t per pc about 1411 (80% range 1047 to 2122); revealed per pc: 1352-1445 (case 38)
- line 2 "Installation": indemnified in 1 of 6 earlier cases, t = 0 in 5; when indemnified t per pc about 482 (80% range 358 to 724); revealed per pc: 468-488 (case 38)
- line 4 "Freight shipping": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 42 (80% range 31 to 63); revealed per pc: 40-43 (case 38)
- line 6 "Contractor administration fee": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 8 earlier cases; no price evidence

items.rationale: The fixed unit sustained covered lightning-surge damage under 2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Sections 7.1.9–7.1.10 cap payment at €1,411 for an equivalent 3.5 kW replacement, excluding the extra cost of the 7.1 kW upgrade.
Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.11 cover ordinary removal, installation, connection and commissioning. Allow €482 for equivalent reinstatement, excluding any extra labour attributable to the upgrade.
The console was chosen for appearance and was not needed to install the replacement. Sections 7.1.10 and 3.5(d) exclude the entire line.
Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage at €42 for an equivalent unit, excluding any additional freight cost due to the larger model or timed service.
Section 7.1.12 excludes express and timed delivery premiums unless agreed in advance or necessary to mitigate further loss. Neither exception is shown, so none of the surcharge is payable.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration and paperwork charges in full.
